content: We test the performance of all baseline systems using the three generative metrics mentioned in Section SECREF22 . As shown in Table TABREF40 , there is a large performance gap between human performance and all baseline methods, including BERT, which has achieved superhuman performance on SQuAD. This confirms than TweetQA is more challenging than formal-test RC tasks.
